title: Joe and Sam Hopkins playing on Bourbon Street
summary: Williams recalls Joe Hopkins, who plays near Two Sisters on Bourbon Street, and his brother Sam Hopkins.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Some of them I really forgot their names. But I remember during the time when I was coming up to this bar, Joe Hopkins, he played nice piano. Hopkins, I don't even know that.
Is he still living you think?
Yeah. Oh yeah. Does he play, he still play, right? Yeah, he still play.
You know where he playing? Right in the corner of the two sisters right now. Oh, on Ronald Street now?
Oh. Oh. But at the Bourbon Street. Yeah, they have a trope on the front street on Bourbon Street.
Oh, yeah, on the Bourbon Street, yeah. Yeah, you know the code two sisters where they can enter? Well, they got a little place right there. Right on the side. Yeah, that's the other one.
Yeah, not where the stroke man, what's his name, Henry?
The old Henry, no, right in the middle of the Henry. Yeah, they call him Joe Hopkins. And he got a brother who plays piano and sings very well. They call him Sam Hopkins.
But is he working there? Sam.
